title: Why does the handle attribute changes algorithm of popover associate with all HTML elements
body:
You have the following:

> The following [attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext), given element, localName, oldValue, value, and namespace, are used for all [HTML elements](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#html-elements):
> 
> 1. If namespace is not null, then return.
> 2. If localName is not [popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-popover), then return.
> 3. If element's [popover visibility state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#popover-visibility-state) is in the [showing state](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#popover-showing-state) and oldValue and value are in different [states](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-popover), then run the [hide popover algorithm](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#hide-popover-algorithm) given element, true, true, and false.

But how the above can work with for example this:

> The following [attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext) are used for the [nonce](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-nonce) content attribute:
> 
> 1. If element does not [include](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#include) [HTMLOrSVGElement](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#htmlorsvgelement), then return.
> 2. If localName is not [nonce](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-nonce) or namespace is not null, then return.
> 3. If value is null, then set element's [[[CryptographicNonce]]](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#cryptographicnonce) to the empty string.
> 4. Otherwise, set element's [[[CryptographicNonce]]](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#cryptographicnonce) to value.

I mean the first thing determinated for all **HTML elements** and the second only for content attribute **nonce**. But if some invokes the [attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext) what will it mean:

- Both algorithms will be invoked or
- Only one algorithm will be invoked (which one and why?)

---

By the way, why the popover's [attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext) doesn't apply same way as for the nonce content attribute algorithm?

Why this can't be deleted

> If localName is not [popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-popover), then return.

with modification to:

> The following [attribute change steps](https://dom.spec.whatwg.org/#concept-element-attributes-change-ext), given element, localName, oldValue, value, and namespace, are used for the [popover](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#attr-popover) attribute

---

Would be better if spec become clearer, because some expanding in spec makes the mess sometimes.
